race.comment: RIMBAUD (4) drops back a trip after battling away to finish second over 1400m at the Farm three weeks ago. Has been in the money at six of nine runs at or around today's distance. Should race handy and give a good account again. SILENCIO PORFAVOR (10) stepped up to Saturday grade and was only beaten 1.6 lengths last time out over 1200m at Rosehill. Beautifully drawn and gets in nicely after Grima's claim. Poses a serious threat. SNACK BAR (1) twice placed at Group 3 level as a younger horse but cannot recapture that glory. Loomed to win but couldn't finish the job at Rosehill last time. Must be considered dropping back to this level. CLEAR PROOF (6) ran the talented Watson to a head when they clashed at this track a fortnight ago. Cherry ripe after three runs back from a spell and is more than capable of testing this field. USEAPIN (11) wasn't pushed out in the same race as CLEAR PROOF here last time. Best form stacks up so this is not out of the question.
